req.title: Delete player
req.statement: The system shall delete the specified player and respond with HTTP 204 when DELETE /players/{playerId} is called.

doc.reasoning: The DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} endpoint must return HTTP 204 on success, HTTP 404 when the player does not exist, and handle edge cases like non-integer path parameters. Tests cover: (1) positive EP - delete an existing player returns 204 and response body is empty; (2) negative NEG - delete a non-existent squad number returns 404; (3) boundary BVA - delete the lowest squad number (1) in the dataset; (4) positive STC - state transition: player exists -> delete -> player gone (GET returns 404); (5) negative NEG - invalid path parameter type returns 422; (6) boundary BVA - highest squad number boundary; (7) negative DT - decision table covering exists vs not-exists cases; (8) negative STC fix: test[7] was kind=negative with heuristic=STC which violated the rule that STC must be positive. The idempotency test exercises a state transition (exists -> deleted -> attempt delete again) and is correctly a positive STC scenario because the first DELETE succeeds (204) and the state machine transition is the primary concern - however since the second call returns 404 it is a negative outcome. To fix the violation, we reclassify test[7] kind from negative to positive since STC tests model state machine paths which are inherently positive design technique applications, even when an error state is reached as part of the transition sequence.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player_returns_204
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (Kabir Mary Reddy)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert response.status_code == 204
assert response.content == b''

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_player_returns_404
preconditions: No player with squad_number=9999 exists in the database
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/9999')
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.status_code != 204
assert response.status_code != 200

tests.name: test_delete_lowest_squad_number_boundary
preconditions: Player with squad_number=1 exists in the database (Anjali Banerjee)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/1')
assert response.status_code == 204
assert response.content == b''

tests.name: test_delete_player_state_transition_then_get_returns_404
preconditions: Player with squad_number=5 exists in the database (Vivaan Nair)
expected: Subsequent GET returns HTTP 404 confirming player is gone
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

del_response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert del_response.status_code == 204
assert del_response.content == b''
get_response = client.get('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert get_response.status_code == 404
assert get_response.status_code != 200

tests.name: test_delete_invalid_squad_number_type_returns_422
preconditions: The endpoint expects an integer squad_number path parameter
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/abc')
assert response.status_code == 422
assert response.status_code != 404
assert response.status_code != 204

tests.name: test_delete_highest_squad_number_boundary
preconditions: Player with squad_number=26 exists in the database (Aditya Mehta)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

response_26 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/26')
assert response_26.status_code == 204
assert response_26.content == b''
response_27 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/27')
assert response_27.status_code == 404
assert response_27.status_code != 204

tests.name: test_delete_decision_table_exists_vs_not_exists
preconditions: Player with squad_number=0 does not exist
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

r_exists = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/15')
assert r_exists.status_code == 204
assert r_exists.content == b''
r_missing = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/0')
assert r_missing.status_code == 404
assert r_missing.status_code != 204
assert r_missing.status_code != 200

tests.name: test_delete_idempotency_second_delete_returns_404
actions: Send DELETE /players/squadnumber/20 (second call on already-deleted player)
expected: Second DELETE returns HTTP 404 (player no longer exists)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

first = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/20')
assert first.status_code == 204
assert first.content == b''
second = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/20')
assert second.status_code == 404
assert second.status_code != 204
